zh-Hans: 别得意，前面的路段我会一口气甩掉你！
en: Don't get cocky. I'll leave you behind in the next section!

zh-Hans: 这混蛋，晃来晃去真碍眼！
en: You bastard! Stop darting around in my way!
You're in my way!
I said move, you bastard!

zh-Hans: 烦死了，凭什么我得在后面跑？！
en: This is pissing me off! Why am I the one behind?!

zh-Hans: 窜来窜去的，真让人火大！
en: All that darting around! You're getting on my nerves!

zh-Hans: 开什么玩笑，都到这一步了，怎么能输！
en: You've got to be kidding! I can't come this far and lose!

zh-Hans: 以为你逃得掉？开什么玩笑！
en: You think you can get away? Don't make me laugh!

zh-Hans: 想逃是吧？混蛋，别以为你已经赢了！
en: Running away? Don't think you've won, you bastard!
Tch. I'll let you lead for now.
Hmph. I'll watch him for now.
You bastard. You'll pay for this later!
He passed me? You've got to be kidding!

zh-Hans: 开得这么乱来！那我也有我的办法！
en: Driving like a maniac! Fine, I've got a plan of my own!
Don't think this is over!
You bastard! What kind of pass was that?!

zh-Hans: 把我的空间都堵死了，开什么玩笑！
en: He's blocked off my space! Damn it!
This pisses me off! I won't accept a win like that!
This is bad!
You bastard! You've got to be kidding!
No way! I'm not accepting this!
Ugh!
Grr...
This pisses me off!
Huh?!
Grr...

zh-Hans: 可恶，赚不到钱的比赛，谁爱跑谁跑！
en: Damn it! A battle that doesn't pay isn't worth my time!
This has to be some kind of mistake!
I won't accept it! This is impossible!

zh-Hans: 趁他还在陌生的赛道上摸不着头脑，一口气甩开！
en: I'll pull away while he's still struggling with an unfamiliar course!

zh-Hans: 我又不是傻子，这次就稳稳地赢下来！
en: I'm not stupid. I'll make sure I win this one!

zh-Hans: 开局不错，这场我拿下了！
en: A good start. This battle's mine!

zh-Hans: 轻松得很，就这么甩掉你！
en: Too easy. I'll leave you behind!
He can keep up with this pace?!
I can't shake him! What the hell is going on?!
He won't drop back. Why?

zh-Hans: 嘿嘿，果然没什么了不起！
en: Heh-heh! You're nothing special after all!

zh-Hans: 就这么一口气甩开，让你彻底泄气！
en: I'll pull away in one shot and crush your spirits!
As if I'd lose!

zh-Hans: 本来还可以再陪你玩会儿呢。
en: I could've played with you a little longer.

zh-Hans: 我怎么可能输给这种废物！
en: There's no way I'd lose to a loser like you!
No way I'm losing! This is easy!
Idiot! You went in too hard!

zh-Hans: 接下来我一口气甩开，就此结束！
en: Now I'll leave you in the dust. The end!

zh-Hans: 别以为还有机会再超过去！
en: Don't think you'll get another chance to pass!

zh-Hans: 我会输？那是百分之两百不可能！
en: Me, lose? That's two hundred percent impossible!
Heh-heh.
Heh.
Heh, slowpoke!
Idiot.
Don't underestimate me!
Don't underestimate me, idiot!
You're unbelievably bad!

zh-Hans: 就这水平，还好意思当车手！
en: How can you call yourself a racer, driving like that?

zh-Hans: 这家伙不行，根本没法比。
en: This guy's hopeless. No contest.

zh-Hans: 让你尝尝小看我们的下场！
en: I'll show you what happens when you underestimate us!
